description: Dear Rep. Thompson, I'm writing to formally invite you to a series of debates ahead of the November election. We're proposing: Nine in-person debates, one in each county of the district. Every community in this newly drawn district deserves the same access to both candidates, not just the count
paid_for_by: Paid for by Eric Jones for Congress
title: Letter to Thompson’s Campaign Issuing a Debate Challenge — Eric Jones for Congress
